costs.name: Production electronics and pulse circuitry
costs.description: Controller, PCB, charging circuit and pulse electronics.
costs.assumptions: No bill of materials or supplier quote. Electrical design must be reviewed by qualified engineers; no build instructions are supplied.

costs.name: Rechargeable battery
costs.description: Power source for the wearable.
costs.assumptions: Adafruit 100+ tier, excluding shipping and tax. Quantity tier and safe fit require verification; no engineering endorsement.

costs.name: Enclosure, strap and contacts
costs.description: Skin-contact wearable housing and band.
costs.assumptions: Small-run allowance, not a supplier quote. Material compatibility and comfort remain untested.

costs.name: Assembly labor and employer burden
costs.description: Assembly and basic inspection per device.
costs.assumptions: BLS $45,450 / 2,080 hours × 0.20 hours per device × 1.25 burden = $5.46. Time, burden and location are assumptions; supplier margin is excluded.

costs.name: Per-device quality assurance
costs.description: Functional checks beyond assembly.
costs.assumptions: Allowance separate from basic assembly inspection; validate process and failure rate.

costs.name: Packaging and instructions
costs.description: Protective box, insert and user instructions.
costs.assumptions: Assume $1.50 packaging plus $0.50 printed materials; get quotes.

costs.name: Inbound freight and duties allowance
costs.description: Move purchased parts to the assembly location.
costs.assumptions: Country of origin, tariffs and shipment size are unknown; replace with landed quotes.

costs.name: Outbound shipping paid by venture
costs.description: Deliver one order to a US customer.
costs.assumptions: One device per order; $8 budget uses $7.33 published starting rate as context, not a quote. Battery restrictions and zones can change cost.

costs.name: Pick and pack
costs.description: Prepare each order for dispatch.
costs.assumptions: Assume six minutes at $20/hour. Not a fulfillment-provider quote.

costs.name: Refund and warranty reserve
costs.description: Allowance for refunds, replacements and return handling.
costs.assumptions: 4% of gross sales recorded as a cost reserve, not a revenue deduction; no duplicate refund deduction. Validate actual rates and nonrefunded processing charges.

costs.name: Customer support per order
costs.description: Setup questions and customer care.
costs.assumptions: Assume average 4.5 minutes at $20/hour; no separate fixed support staff in base case.

costs.name: Domestic card processing rate
costs.description: Accept online domestic card payments.
costs.assumptions: Stripe standard domestic card rate. No recurring Billing feature assumed; taxes charged to customers and fees on taxes are excluded.

costs.name: Domestic card processing fixed fee
costs.description: Fixed amount per successful payment.
costs.assumptions: One sale equals one order and one successful domestic charge; change for bundles/multi-item orders.

costs.name: Founder compensation allowance
costs.description: Recognize founder operating effort.
costs.assumptions: Modeled economic compensation, not necessarily deductible salary or owner draw treatment. Taxes and benefits included only in this allowance.

costs.name: Advertising experiments
costs.description: Test messaging and acquire potential customers.
costs.assumptions: Fixed test budget; it does not imply a customer acquisition rate or demand uplift.

costs.name: Creative and content production
costs.description: Photography and educational product content.
costs.assumptions: Contractor budget; avoid claims before performance validation.

costs.name: Firmware and website maintenance
costs.description: Fix software defects and maintain the storefront.
costs.assumptions: Part-time contractor allowance, excluding initial development below.

costs.name: Static storefront hosting
costs.description: Serve informational pages and link to hosted checkout.
costs.assumptions: Netlify free plan reference subject to usage limits. This laboratory uses GitHub Pages; the eventual store platform is unselected.

costs.name: Domain registration
costs.description: Own a recognizable website address.
costs.assumptions: Planning allowance, extension and renewal quote not selected.

costs.name: Email and business software
costs.description: Email, support inbox and basic productivity tools.
costs.assumptions: Combined allowance; no specific subscription selected.

costs.name: Home storage and utility allowance
costs.description: Small-batch inventory storage and incremental utilities.
costs.assumptions: Home-based launch; no commercial office, land purchase or warehouse lease assumed.

costs.name: Product liability and business insurance
costs.description: Budget for operating and product liability cover.
costs.assumptions: Electrical-stimulus wearable eligibility and premium unknown. Obtain specialist underwriting; this budget is not evidence of coverage.

costs.name: Bookkeeping and accounting
costs.description: Maintain records and prepare routine accounts.
costs.assumptions: Scope and business form unconfirmed; not tax advice.

costs.name: Ongoing legal and compliance advice
costs.description: Review customer terms and compliance questions.
costs.assumptions: Does not replace product-specific safety/regulatory review below.

costs.name: Connecticut LLC annual report
costs.description: Annual entity filing under the location assumption.
costs.assumptions: Connecticut LLC is a scenario, not a confirmed registration. Disable/change if a different entity or jurisdiction is selected.

costs.name: Prototype development boards
costs.description: Ten reference boards for engineering experiments.
costs.assumptions: 10 × $29.95 retail reference; bulk quote may differ. Not approved for the final wearable.

costs.name: Initial engineering and firmware
costs.description: Design, prototypes and firmware before launch.
costs.assumptions: No engineering quote. Scope and feasibility unknown.

costs.name: Safety, usability and compliance testing
costs.description: Independent review of electrical, skin-contact, battery and product claims.
costs.assumptions: Scope and applicable approvals must be determined professionally; allowance is not a compliance guarantee.

costs.name: Tooling and test equipment
costs.description: Fixtures and reusable production tooling.
costs.assumptions: Capitalized scenario: straight-line 3 years, zero salvage, full year in service. Depreciation enters accounting break-even; cash remains startup.

costs.name: Entity setup and launch legal work
costs.description: Formation assistance and initial policies.
costs.assumptions: Legal structure unconfirmed. Budget is not the statutory filing fee.

costs.name: Initial inventory working capital
costs.description: Cash tied up in initial parts and finished stock.
costs.assumptions: Working-capital reserve, excluded from operating P&L; sold inventory costs already appear per unit. Not an extra expense.

costs.name: Launch photography and packaging design
costs.description: Create launch assets and initial packaging artwork.
costs.assumptions: One-time quote required; distinct from ongoing content budget.

products.name: Zap Band
products.description: Proposed personal wearable alarm using adjustable electrical pulses to wake its wearer with less disturbance to other people.
products.features: Adjustable wake time and pulse intensity; comfortable wearable form; simple controls. All are design goals pending testing.

website.note: Student setup supplied a live URL in the repository field. No original repository URL was supplied. The inferred repository is a separately labeled candidate; verify before Mission 4.

assumptions: Annual steady-state operating model in USD. Selling quantities are student assumptions, not forecasts.
One sale means one billable device/order; bundle costs must be entered per bundle. Monthly/annual subscriptions are not activated because the documented venture sells hardware.
US direct-to-consumer online, home-based operation and Connecticut LLC are assumptions. No commercial office or full-time employees assumed.
Constant prices, unit costs and sales mix; no capacity constraints, inventory timing, tax, debt, financing or demand elasticity modeled.
Startup cash is shown separately. Only explicit straight-line equipment depreciation enters annual operating costs. Startup expensing and tax treatment require accounting review.
